notes.text: [V2 6088] requires noise exposure levels to be “monitored and quantified for each crewmember”; the requirement names no device, and its rationale’s example is that, on ISS, “the crew uses acoustic monitors to monitor their environment”.

quotes.text: monitored and quantified for each crewmember
the crew uses acoustic monitors to monitor their environment

notes.text: [V2 6020] requires “pressure, humidity, temperature, ppO2, and ppCO2 data” to be recorded automatically for “each isolatable, habitable compartment”; it sets no capacity, retention or duration. The ranking surfaced it, and we narrowed this claim.

quotes.text: pressure, humidity, temperature, ppO2, and ppCO2 data

notes.text: [V2 6153] asks for an alert when celestial dust is “approaching defined limits”; Vol 2 sets the lunar dust limit itself, “below a time-weighted average of 0.3 mg/m3” in [V2 6053], but never says how close counts as “approaching”: that alert point is left to the program.

quotes.text: below a time-weighted average of 0.3 mg/m3
